description: Move several of your Besidka chats into a project, or out of any project with a null projectId. Reports how many moved, how many were already there and which slugs are not your chats. Requires signing in (chats:write).

projectId.description: Project id from list_projects, or null to take the chats out of their projects

name: move_chats_to_project
title: Move chats to a project
